# Tuan Hung Vu Technologies Pte. Ltd.

> A technology company exploring AI security and business-action integrity. Business logic. Protected by design.

## Company and origin
- Sole company brand: Tuan Hung Vu Technologies Pte. Ltd.
- The business story began in 2023 and grew out of an AI-security hackathon in Singapore.
- Accelerated by BLOCK71.
- Address: Ayer Rajah Industrial Estate, Singapore. No street number, unit, building or postal code has been provided.
- No program cohort, hackathon name, award, legal incorporation date or other regional office is claimed.
- Contact: contact@tuanhungvu.com.

## Current work
- A research preview for deterministic verification of AI business actions, not a production enforcement engine.
- Local refund simulation checks business rules, remaining balance, exact approval binding, expiry, replay evidence, and missing trusted state.
- No live agent interception, production integrations, compliance certification, or cryptographic guarantees are claimed.
- USD pilot prices are indicative planning tiers, not a live subscription offer.
